name: The Banjo of Ol' Jericho Sticks

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from the Fields of the Crow; the book's numbers, our words.

summary: A banjo that grows with its bearer: spell attacks and save DCs up by +1, +2 at level 7, +3 at 13; a dance that Disengages (bonus action) and a charm once a dusk that lands even through a demon's immunity. Trapping a charmed creature in the banjo waits on the engine.
